about.title: Thoughtful products, a clear shopping path
about.intro: We built this shop so you can browse, compare, and check out without noise. Catalog details come from our store; the pages around them are here to explain how we work.
about.body: From the first product photo to the order confirmation, we keep the flow simple: honest descriptions, a locked-in total before you pay, and packing that is ready to gift or keep. If something is unclear, write to us and we will help.

values.title: Careful packing
values.text: Orders leave in protective packaging so items arrive ready to use or give.

values.title: Clear totals
values.text: Shipping, tax, and discounts show before you pay. No last-minute surprises.

values.title: Real support
values.text: Reach us by email or phone during opening hours. We reply to order questions first.

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.intro: Shipping, returns, payments, and tracking. If you still need a hand, send us a message.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Add items to your cart, go to checkout, and pay with a card. You will get an order number, order key, and email you can use to track the order.

items.question: Can I track a guest order?
items.answer: Yes. Open Track order and enter the order number, order key, and billing email from your confirmation.

items.question: I need to change an order. What now?
items.answer: Write to us as soon as you can with the order number. If the parcel has not shipped, we will do what we can to update it.

items.question: Do you offer free shipping?
items.answer: Eligible orders include free standard shipping. Delivery windows show at checkout once you enter an address.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Most orders ship within a few business days. Tracking appears as soon as the carrier has the parcel.

items.question: What is the return window?
items.answer: You can request a return within 30 days of delivery. Items should be unused and in original packaging where possible.

items.question: How do I start a return?
items.answer: Contact us with your order number and the items you want to send back. We will share the next step.

items.question: Which cards do you accept?
items.answer: Checkout is encrypted and processed with Stripe. Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and UnionPay are supported on eligible cards, along with wallets Stripe enables for your region.

items.question: Can I pay over time with Affirm or Afterpay?
items.answer: If Affirm or Afterpay is offered on a product page, you can use that pay-over-time option on eligible orders. Messaging on the product shows the installment example when those methods are active.

items.question: Is checkout secure?
items.answer: Yes. Card details go through Stripe. We never store full card numbers on this site.

contact.title: Talk to us
contact.intro: Questions about an order, a product, or a return? Send a note and we will get back during opening hours.
